Calculation Methodology

Freelancer Net Payout = Contract Amount × (1 - Contract Fee Rate [0% to 15%]) - Withdrawal Fee. Gross Bid Required = (Target Net + Withdrawal Fee) / (1 - Contract Fee Rate).

REFERENCE BASIS: Upwork Variable Freelancer Service Fee (0%–15%) • ASSUMPTIONS VERIFIED: 2026-10-27

Reference Notes & FAQ

How do Upwork's 0% to 15% fees and Direct Contract rates work?

Upwork's marketplace freelancer service fee varies from 0% to 15% per contract. For Direct Contracts (clients you bring to Upwork), the standard fee is 5%, while eligible Freelancer Plus subscribers receive a 0% Direct Contract fee.

How much should I bid to take home $1,000 net at an example 10% or 15% fee?

At a 10% rate (before withdrawal fee), bid $1,111.11 ($1,000 / 0.90). At a 15% rate, bid $1,176.47 ($1,000 / 0.85). Select any preset above or enter your exact contract rate.
